root.name: Van Geet Opening: Liebig Gambit
root.moves: 1. Nc3 e5 2. e3 d5 3. Qh5 Nf6

overview: After 1.Nc3 e5 2.e3 d5 White plays 3.Qh5, an early queen sortie hitting e5 and creating threats against f7. Black develops with 3...Nf6 attacking the queen, after which White can take 4.Qxe5+ when Black gets a lead in development. I am not sure of the exact idea of the gambit and the main line.

white_ideas.idea: Use the queen to win e5 and bring the pieces out

black_ideas.idea: Attack the queen with tempo using ...Nf6, ...Nc6
Trade pieces and play on the weakened king

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with early queen sortie

gambit.notes: Material is level at the root.

soundness.notes: The early queen is risky and probably gives Black an edge.
